note: City of Plainview park one block off US-20, with paved, level but narrow drive-in sites on the north side of the park; each pedestal has 50/30/20-amp electric plus water. Reviewers report sites taking ~30-ft rigs, but the city posts no length, so check the pads on arrival. Restrooms, pool, playground, courts; some road noise. --Claude
summary: City page confirms free camping, open year round, 3-day limit (extensions by the City Office) - fees, season and max stay now manual; it says nothing on hookups, site count or reservations (left derived). Website was empty: the city page is the operator's. Pin is on the park's north street, fine. Pad length unposted; caveat kept in the note.
